status.description: done is set by QA alone; merged is the light tier's terminal status, set by the controller after the merge, and carries no acceptance; adopted (0.7.0) is written by pk adopt alone, for a task the programme finished before it adopted the kit: terminal, it satisfies dependencies as done does, but it is never done and evidences nothing

tier.description: the verification tier, set at dispatch and changed only by `pk status tier` with a ruling; absent (a record written before 0.3.0) means full

fast.description: the fast path: BRIEF.md and a ruling replace SPEC, PLAN and spec QA; never true on the full tier

ruling.description: the ruling (R<n>) that allowed the fast path or the last tier change; empty when none was needed

inspected.description: on a merged record only, and required there: the commit whose diff the controller read. main holds a merge of exactly this commit, and `pk status validate` re-runs the light path's guard on it

legacy_status.description: 0.7.0, written by pk adopt: the task's status in the source; done on an adopted record, the source state on a task imported not_started because it was in flight

legacy_actor.description: 0.7.0, written by pk adopt: who set the source status

legacy_updated_at.description: 0.7.0, written by pk adopt: when, as in the source

references.description: 0.7.0, written by pk adopt on an adopted record and kept on a reopen: the task's legacy evidence, each a file under legacy_evidence_roots with the sha256 of its blob at adopted_commit; pk status validate checks both

evidence.description: paths relative to the project root

legacy_status.description: 0.7.0, written by pk adopt: the task's status in the source; done on an adopted record, the source state on a task imported not_started because it was in flight

legacy_actor.description: 0.7.0, written by pk adopt: who set the source status

legacy_updated_at.description: 0.7.0, written by pk adopt: when, as in the source

references.description: 0.7.0, written by pk adopt on an adopted record and kept on a reopen: the task's legacy evidence, each a file under legacy_evidence_roots with the sha256 of its blob at adopted_commit; pk status validate checks both

tier.description: present on the dispatch entry (the first move to in_progress) and on the entry a tier change appends; the record's tier must be the last one named here

reason.description: present on an entry `pk status reopen` appends: why a done task was moved back
